description: Header file defining classes and structures for media capabilities caching and codec information, including Range, CodecCapability, AudioCodecCapability, VideoCodecCapability, and MediaCapabilitiesCache, within the starboard::android::shared namespace.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: Represents a numerical range with minimum and maximum values, with a method to check if a value is within the range.

classes.name: CodecCapability
classes.description: Base class for codec capabilities, storing codec name and support/security flags.

classes.name: AudioCodecCapability
classes.description: Derived class for audio codec capabilities, including bitrate support.

classes.name: VideoCodecCapability
classes.description: Derived class for video codec capabilities, including resolution, bitrate, and frame rate support.

classes.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache
classes.description: Singleton class managing media capabilities, decoder support, and configurations.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a value falls within the range.

methods.name: CodecCapability
methods.description: Constructor initializing codec info from JNI environment and Java object.

methods.name: IsBitrateSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given bitrate is supported by the codec.

methods.name: AreResolutionAndRateSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific resolution and frame rate are supported.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MediaCapabilitiesCache.

methods.name: IsWidevineSupported
methods.description: Checks if Widevine DRM is supported.

methods.name: IsCbcsSchemeSupported
methods.description: Checks if Cbcs scheme is supported.

methods.name: IsHDRTransferCharacteristicsSupported
methods.description: Checks HDR transfer characteristics support for a transfer ID.

methods.name: IsPassthroughSupported
methods.description: Checks if passthrough is supported for a given audio codec.

methods.name: GetAudioConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves an audio configuration by index.

methods.name: HasAudioDecoderFor
methods.description: Determines if an audio decoder exists for specified MIME type and bitrate.

methods.name: HasVideoDecoderFor
methods.description: Determines if a video decoder exists for specified parameters.

methods.name: FindAudioDecoder
methods.description: Finds an audio decoder for specified MIME type and bitrate.

methods.name: FindVideoDecoder
methods.description: Finds a video decoder for specified parameters.

methods.name: SetCacheEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the media capabilities cache.

methods.name: ClearCache
methods.description: Clears the cached media capabilities data.
